map.：铝合金压铸件重 5kg、平均壁厚 5mm：压铸经济壁厚 1.5–6mm，5mm: An aluminium die casting weighing 5kg with an average wall of 5mm: the economical die-casting range is 1.5-6mm, so 5mm is feasible; below 1.5mm filling is poor and cold shuts appear.
map.：压铸节拍约 1–2 分钟/件，重力铸造约 10–20 分钟/件，大批量下压铸单: Die casting runs about 1-2 minutes per part while gravity casting takes about 10-20 minutes, so at high volume die casting cuts unit cost several-fold, but the tooling investment is high.
map.压铸最小壁厚多少？: What Is the Minimum Wall Thickness for Die Casting?
map.锌合金约 0.5–1mm、铝 1–1.5mm、镁更薄；过薄充型困难、强度不足，需: Zinc alloy is about 0.5-1mm, aluminium 1-1.5mm and magnesium thinner; too thin makes filling hard and strength insufficient, so structural ribs must be considered.
map.压铸适合小批吗？: Is Die Casting Suitable for Small Batches?
map.不适合，模具贵、摊销高；大批量（万级以上）才经济，小批选砂型或金属型铸造更灵活。: Not suitable: the tooling is expensive and heavily amortized. It only pays off in large batches (tens of thousands and above); small batches are more flexible with sand or permanent mould casting.
